name: @conductor/library
description: Local, server-less retrieval engine over node:sqlite + FTS5 (docs/adr/0006-fase5-library-and-grounding.md D1/D8): hybrid lexical+dense search, code-aware indexing, and the runtime-derived grounding ledger that @conductor/runtime's recordGroundedDecision resolves citations against. Zero @conductor/* dependencies -- I/O lives at the edges (node:sqlite, node:fs, node:dns/net, node:crypto), pure policy (fts-query/query-enrichment/hybrid-search/chunking) in the middle (ADR §11.1).
